Frequently asked questions

Is my file uploaded to a server?
No. The conversion runs in your browser, so the file stays on your device. Only program components (such as the PDF library) are downloaded from this site; for HEIC and MP3 one extra component is also loaded from jsDelivr. Your file is not sent along.
What file formats can I convert?
Images (JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC, GIF, BMP, AVIF), PDF (to images, merge, split, rotate, delete pages, compress), and audio from video (MP3/WAV). If you need Word or Excel conversion, that is not available yet.
What is the file size limit?
Ubahin allows 200 MB per file, but the real limit depends on your device memory. Very large files can make the browser slow or stop.
Is it free? Do I need to sign up?
Free, with no account. There is no watermark on the results.
How do I shrink a photo for an application form?
Open Compress Photo to 100 KB, 200 KB, or 500 KB to match the form limit, pick your photo, then download the result. Quality is lowered just enough to reach the target. For ID photos, use the ID Photo 3×4 tool first.
Why is it slow, or why did the result not get smaller?
Everything is processed on your device, so speed depends on your phone or computer. Videos and large PDFs take longer, and the screen should stay on. A result may not shrink when the file is already very efficient; in that case the original size is kept.
Can I use it on iPhone and Android?
Yes. Ubahin runs in modern browsers such as Chrome, Safari, Edge, and Firefox. There is nothing to install. HEIC photos from iPhone can be converted to JPG.
Is there a limit on the number of files or a daily quota?
There is no daily quota and no account is needed. The limit is 200 MB per file and your device memory.
